svg.title: Figure 10 · Nelson–Siegel parameter interpretation
svg.desc: All other Nelson–Siegel coefficients remain β₀ = 3.5%, β₁ = −2%, β₂ = 2.5%. A decay time is not itself an interest rate and does not move the long-run level.
